_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: OEM Maintenance History Data
summary: The OEM Maintenance History Data DID is used to track parts usage, categorize failures, identify test failures, quantify No Fault Found instances, document Repair Turn-Around Time, and support U.S. Government failure analysis.
use_relationship:
The Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) Maintenance History Data will be used to track parts usage, categorize failures, identify test failures, quantify instances of No Fault Found, document Repair Turn-Around Time, link repaired items back to removal from the end item, and provide the U.S. Government with data for use in failure analysis.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the contract.
This DID supersedes DI-PSSS-82325.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The OEM Maintenance History Data shall contain two Maintenance History Data files that adhere to the following characteristics so that they can be imported into U.S. Government databases:

children.title: Formatted as a pipe delimited text file
Trimmed field values (no spaces at beginning or end of field values)
Inclusion of every field listed in this DID; if no data is available for field, leave null between pipe separators

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: OEM Maintenance History Data shall consist of two files:

children.title: Inducted_Assembly_Maintenance.csv
children.content: This table shall include a single record for each maintenance action completed since the last submission. There shall be one record for each inducted assembly. In the event that previously reported records have been updated during the interval since the last extract, those updated records shall also be included in the incremental file. This file shall include the fields, formats, and any data specifications listed in Table 1, below.

children.title: Sub_Assembly_And_Piece_Parts.csv
children.content: This table shall include a single record for each sub-assembly and a single record for each piece part replaced or repaired in conjunction with the completed maintenance actions reported in 3.1 Inducted_Assembly_Maintenance. There shall be one record for each sub-assembly, and one for each piece part repaired or replaced as part of the overall maintenance action on the inducted assembly. This file shall include the fields, formats, and any data specifications listed in Table 2, below.
